scope: Retained sequential native seed777 benchmarks; no new production policy changes.
limits: Candidate membership is not a proof of safe removal. Group projections use existing cell count and exact context/base entity boundaries; ignore encoded bytes and explicit publication boundaries. Every original fact/reference must remain resolvable.
examples: Illustrative excerpts only; long lists and nested maps truncated with explicit counts. Original records remain in the referenced trace.
